title: xDrip issue: master recieving readings but followers receive missed readings
symptom: The master is receiving readings correctly, but followers receive the readings as missed readings, showing 'missed reading since 60 minutes' even though new readings are being sent.
evidence_quote: My xDrip is working and I am the master, I am recieving readings but the rest of my followers also do receive the reading but just in the form of missed readings.
